'''Echo Nine''' was the callsign of a [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] patrol for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
